milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The agent must navigate close enough to the lectern (within 4 blocks) and face toward it (within 60° tolerance). The lectern is at spawn-relative coordinates (0, 1, 8), centered on the back wall of a cobblestone building 8 blocks ahead of spawn. A max_distance of 4 ensures the agent has walked forward to at least z≈4, meaning they are at or inside the building doorway (entrance at z=5), with clear line of sight to the lectern. This prevents trivial completion from spawn (which is 8 blocks away, well outside the 4-block threshold). The facing_tolerance of 60° confirms the agent is actively looking at the lectern.
